narratives.Overview: 1. Warrant and limits. Detect newly acquired storage, cookies, non-GET or non-admitted-origin network, and markup submission capabilities in changed HTML/JSX/TSX under a recorded presentation ceiling, compared with merge-base. Same-origin GET, in-memory state, and standalone CSS remain excluded. Do not widen FACT_KINDS or harvest JSX/TSX into intent-constraint production suffixes. A pass establishes this bounded static policy, not arbitrary JavaScript equivalence or universal presentation-only authorization. 2. One ceiling contract Use the same ceiling discovery/decoding rules as #5056, including supported xBRIEF change-class records and the dedicated artifact. Combine applicable restrictions rather than selecting one record. An existing restriction cannot be disarmed by head edits/deletion; an added restriction arms immediately. Missing records differ from failed reads or malformed records; failures refuse with a named cause. Amendments require a merge-base human-approval record bound to that ceiling. A list or bare humanOrigin boolean is not approval. Define/test one typed representation for admitted origins, package specifiers, global members, and file paths. Honor supported fields; reject malformed/unsupported fields. Same-PR amendments cannot authorize the diff. Do not create an independent policy store. If #5056 is not landed, align with its actual public shapes and test compatibility without claiming the dependency is integrated. 3. Explicit snapshots Read exactly the snapshot checked: live working-tree bytes locally (including staged changes unless overwritten), committed checkout in CI. Deletion is absence; never resurrect index/HEAD content. I/O/git failure is not absence. Compare against a resolved merge-base snapshot. Apply the same semantics to additions, edits, deletions, renames, and ceiling records; report configuration errors explicitly. 4. Acquisition occurrences Compare normalized acquisition-site occurrences, preserving multiplicity and effect-relevant arguments, receiver, and source. A category in the base does not authorize later occurrences. Absolute offsets are diagnostic locations, not identities. Whitespace, comments, and unrelated insertions above a site must not make it new. Changing GET to POST, target/receiver, or adding a duplicate must refuse. Deleting/formatting an existing site must continue. Cross-file moves may remain conservative unless unambiguously matched; disclose that limit. The document-base prohibition remains a separately recomputed global condition. 5. Independent executable-JavaScript analysis Traverse every executable expression, including host children, attributes, handlers, computed accesses, initializers, and nested functions. Attribute exemption does not exempt execution. Use lexical binding identity, not a global name map. Resolve immutable aliases with cycle detection. Unsupported mutation/provenance, dynamic import, reflection, unknown globals, and unclassifiable executable acquisition paths refuse. No arbitrary alias-depth cutoff may silently accept a remainder. Retain supplying-edge ownership for unchanged caller capabilities, but establish the recognized forwarding form and inspect in-class suppliers. A local declaration or familiar method name alone is not safety evidence. Per-global member allowlists are explicit; an empty set is not unrestricted access. DOM/window/ref-derived capabilities need explicit safe treatment or refusal. Bound the supported static language rather than claiming to prove arbitrary JavaScript. Respect last-property-wins and evaluation order for fetch options. Resolve supported literal/computed names; refuse unresolved spreads, keys, getters, aliases, or options unless their complete result is established. Aliased/direct network calls and XHR method changes have equivalent outcomes. Decode JS literals as JavaScript and quoted JSX attributes as JSX; changing quote style cannot change the verdict. 6. Inert native values and potential channels Known inert native attributes (title, alt, class/className, ordinary ARIA text) and harmless scalar boolean/numeric values are not network acquisitions merely because they contain a URL or conditional. Executable subexpressions still undergo rule 4. Use a positive inert-value exemption, not a short exhaustive request-attribute list: unrecognized attributes/namespaces receive conservative classification, including legacy background and future channels. Custom elements/component props are not presumed inert by attribute name. Component props/children retain conservative supplier checking unless local static use proves a value inert. Permit harmless scalar literals; unknown string/object consumers retain URL/value checks. Disclose remaining false positives. Preserve both HTML parse modes, namespaces, template contents, handler/CSS safeguards, document-base checks, and submission overrides. 7. Complete values and channel grammars When immutable locals statically resolve a value, decode/assemble it completely before URL classification under the sink's grammar. Individually safe fragments do not prove safe composition. URL-list sinks such as srcSet refuse unresolved interpolation; admit fully resolved static lists or approved whole-value forwarding. Unknown component consumers cannot be assumed single-URL. Only known single-URL sinks may use pinned-path-prefix reasoning for unresolved identity/member interpolation after executable/provenance checks. Static-chunk separators alone never prove single-URL shape. Preserve same-origin static lists and ordinary single-URL paths. Forwarding does not exempt locally constructed/reassigned values. Required refusal: const a = "a.png 1x, https"; const b = "://collector.example/p 2x"; . The emitted second candidate is https://collector.example/p. Test parameter/object-member variants and same-origin controls. 8. Verification and delivery Add real-git fixtures for staged/unstaged/committed changes/deletions, ceiling discovery, amendment authority, duplicate/shifted effects, and changed methods. Add syntax-equivalence tests for aliases, scopes, computed members, property ordering, JSX children, string decoding, composition, and harmless presentation controls. Retain valid earlier fixtures, correcting explicitly superseded rows. Measure changed-code coverage and run the full check before push. Update the active #5080 brief, tracked design doc, changelog, and PR description. Resolve review conversations with evidence. Completion requires current-HEAD checks and Greptile 5/5. Fix this existing PR; merging is outside the current request.

P1 is acquisition of a durable or externally observable effect capability inside an already presentation-class `.tsx` / `.jsx` / `.html` path (including inline `<script>`), under a recorded presentation ceiling, with no checked throw/reject/abort or numeric-const fact. Ownership map (verbatim from #5059 Stop 1 5859093034): **Forwarding** a caller-supplied value — passing a parameter, or a value derived only from parameters and file-locals, onward as a prop, argument, or handler — acquires nothing. A literal `

The proposed induction over host global/import/listed markup channels is incomplete for the warrant as written. **Disposition.** Do not bind the broad network/external-effect closure with this channel set.
